capabilities: Collect article links from a Gmail label and RSS or Atom feeds
Extract article text, authors and dates, deduplicating by URL or title
Generate a newsletter note through editable per-step AI prompts
Produce a black-and-white 4/3 illustration via the OpenAI API
Track used articles across editions and regenerate a day's note
extras: README is in French. The Google OAuth client file is not distributed with releases and must be supplied by the user; without it the Gmail connection button stays unavailable. The plugin is free under the MIT license and does not publish to Substack or send to subscribers.
problem: Turning alerts, feeds and emailed links into a ready-to-edit press review requires collecting sources and drafting outside Obsidian by hand.

relations.evidence: Codex : installer et connecter Codex CLI sur la machine.
Pour une newsletter en français, les corrections typographiques de Finition sont appliquées localement

requires.name: Google OAuth desktop client (oauth-client.json) placed in the plugin folder
OpenAI or Anthropic key, or a local OpenAI-compatible server; Codex CLI as an alternative for text

summary: AI-assisted press-review generator that collects articles from a Gmail label and RSS feeds, then writes an illustrated newsletter note in the vault.
